/*=====================================================
    Declarare Statusuri
=====================================================*/
DECLARE @StatusDraft INT
DECLARE @StatusBlocat INT
DECLARE @StatusConfirmat INT

SELECT @StatusDraft = Id
FROM app.StatusCalcul
WHERE Denumire = 'Draft'

SELECT @StatusBlocat = Id
FROM app.StatusCalcul
WHERE Denumire = 'Blocat'

SELECT @StatusConfirmat = Id
FROM app.StatusCalcul
WHERE Denumire = 'Confirmat'


/*=====================================================
    Creare ControlLichidare daca nu exista
=====================================================*/
IF NOT EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM app.ControlLichidare
    WHERE Anul = @Anul
      AND Luna = @Luna
      AND CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
)
BEGIN

    INSERT INTO app.ControlLichidare
    (
        Anul,
        Luna,
        CodSucursala,
        Status,
        CreatDe,
        DataCreare
    )
    VALUES
    (
        @Anul,
        @Luna,
        @CodSucursala,
        @StatusDraft,
        @UserName,
        GETDATE()
    )

END


/*=====================================================
    Validare stare luna
=====================================================*/
DECLARE @StatusCurent INT

SELECT @StatusCurent = Status
FROM app.ControlLichidare
WHERE Anul = @Anul
  AND Luna = @Luna
  AND CodSucursala = @CodSucursala


IF @StatusCurent IS NULL
BEGIN
    RAISERROR ('Nu exista ControlLichidare.',16,1)
    RETURN
END


IF @StatusCurent = @StatusBlocat
BEGIN
    RAISERROR ('Luna este blocata.',16,1)
    RETURN
END

SET NOCOUNT ON;

BEGIN TRY

INSERT INTO app.CalculLichidare
(
-------------------------------------------------
-- Identificare
-------------------------------------------------
IdSalariat,
CodSucursala,
Marca,
Nume,

Luna,
Anul,

DataCalcul,

Status,

-------------------------------------------------
-- Contract
-------------------------------------------------
TipNorma,
SalariuBrut,

ProcentLoialitate,
ProcentContinuitate,

-------------------------------------------------
-- Prezenta
-------------------------------------------------
ZileLucratoare,
ZileLucrate,
ZileCO,
ZileCM,

OreLucrate,

-------------------------------------------------
-- Bruturi
-------------------------------------------------
SalBrutEfectiv,

BrutCO,
BrutCM,

TotalBrut,
BrutContributiv,
BrutImpozabil,

-------------------------------------------------
-- Fiscalitate
-------------------------------------------------
VenitImpozabil,
BazaImpozabila,

CAS,
CASS,
CAM,

DeducereStandard,
DeducereSuplimentara,
DeducereFinala,

ImpozitVenit,

-------------------------------------------------
-- Sporuri / indemnizatii
-------------------------------------------------
ValoareLoialitate,
ValoareContinuitate,

IndemnizatieCFP,
IndemnizatieConducere,
IndemnizatieProgramFractionat,

-------------------------------------------------
-- Alte venituri
-------------------------------------------------
Agenti,
Remiza,
AlteDrepturi,

TicheteMasa,

ValoareOreLucrate,

-------------------------------------------------
-- Retineri
-------------------------------------------------
CAR,

PensiiAlimentare,
PensiiFacultative,

Chirii,
Casa,
Banca,

Garantii,

Popriri,
Imputatii,

AlteRate,

TotalRetineri,

-------------------------------------------------
-- Net
-------------------------------------------------
VenitNet,
SalariuNet,
NetDePlata,

-------------------------------------------------
-- Audit
-------------------------------------------------
CreatedDate,
LastModifiedDate

)

SELECT

-------------------------------------------------
-- Identificare
-------------------------------------------------
s.Id,
s.CodSucursala,
s.Marca,
s.Nume,

@Luna,
@Anul,

GETDATE(),

(
    SELECT Id
    FROM app.StatusCalcul
    WHERE Denumire = 'Draft'
),

-------------------------------------------------
-- Contract
-------------------------------------------------
s.TipNorma,

ISNULL(ngs.Salariu,0),

ISNULL(s.ProcentLoialitate,0),
ISNULL(s.ProcentContinuitate,0),

-------------------------------------------------
-- Prezenta
-------------------------------------------------
ISNULL(ep.ZileLucratoare,0),
ISNULL(ep.ZileLucrate,0),
ISNULL(ep.ZileCO,0),
ISNULL(ep.ZileCM,0),

ISNULL(ep.OreLucrate,0),

-------------------------------------------------
-- Bruturi
-------------------------------------------------
ISNULL(bcb.BrutLucrat,0),

ISNULL(bcb.BrutCO,0),
ISNULL(bcb.BrutCM,0),

ISNULL(bc.BrutTotal,0),

ISNULL(bc.BrutContributiv,0),

ISNULL(bc.BrutImpozabil,0),

-------------------------------------------------
-- Fiscalitate
-------------------------------------------------
ISNULL(bc.VenitImpozabil,0),

ISNULL(bc.BazaImpozabila,0),

ISNULL(bc.CAS,0),
ISNULL(bc.CASS,0),
ISNULL(bc.CAM,0),

ISNULL(bc.DeducereStandard,0),

ISNULL(bc.DeducereSuplimentara,0),

0,--ISNULL(bc.DeducereFinala,0),

ISNULL(bc.ImpozitFinal,0),

-------------------------------------------------
-- Sporuri / indemnizatii
-------------------------------------------------
ISNULL(bcb.BrutLoialitate,0),

ISNULL(bcb.BrutContinuitate,0),

ISNULL(bcb.BrutCFP,0),

ISNULL(bcb.BrutConducere,0),

ISNULL(bcb.BrutProgramFractionat,0),

-------------------------------------------------
-- Alte venituri
-------------------------------------------------
ISNULL(bcb.BrutAgenti,0),

ISNULL(bcb.BrutRemize,0),

ISNULL(bcb.BrutAlteDrepturi,0),

ISNULL(bcb.ValoareTicheteMasa,0),

ISNULL(bcb.BrutLucrat,0),

-------------------------------------------------
-- Retineri
-------------------------------------------------
ISNULL(car2.CAR,0),

ISNULL(pa.PensiiAlimentare,0),

ISNULL(ret.PensiiFacultative,0),

ISNULL(ret.Chirii,0),

ISNULL(ret.Casa,0),

ISNULL(ret.Banca,0),

0,

ISNULL(pop.Popriri,0),

ISNULL(imp.Imputatii,0),

0,

-------------------------------------------------
-- Total retineri
-------------------------------------------------
(
    ISNULL(car2.CAR,0)
    + ISNULL(pa.PensiiAlimentare,0)
    + ISNULL(ret.PensiiFacultative,0)
    + ISNULL(ret.Chirii,0)
    + ISNULL(ret.Casa,0)
    + ISNULL(ret.Banca,0)
    + ISNULL(pop.Popriri,0)
    + ISNULL(imp.Imputatii,0)
),

-------------------------------------------------
-- Venit Net
-------------------------------------------------
(
ISNULL(bc.VenitImpozabil,0)
- ISNULL(bc.ImpozitFinal,0)
),

-------------------------------------------------
-- Salariu Net
-------------------------------------------------
(
ISNULL(bc.VenitImpozabil,0)
- ISNULL(bc.ImpozitFinal,0)
),

-------------------------------------------------
-- Net de plata
-------------------------------------------------
(
(
ISNULL(bc.VenitImpozabil,0)
- ISNULL(bc.ImpozitFinal,0)
)

-

(
    ISNULL(car2.CAR,0)
    + ISNULL(pa.PensiiAlimentare,0)
    + ISNULL(ret.PensiiFacultative,0)
    + ISNULL(ret.Chirii,0)
    + ISNULL(ret.Casa,0)
    + ISNULL(ret.Banca,0)
    + ISNULL(pop.Popriri,0)
    + ISNULL(imp.Imputatii,0)
)

),

-------------------------------------------------
-- Audit
-------------------------------------------------
GETDATE(),
GETDATE()

FROM app.Salariat s

LEFT JOIN app.ExceptiiPrezenta ep
ON ep.Marca = s.Marca
AND ep.Anul = @Anul
AND ep.Luna = @Luna
AND ep.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

LEFT JOIN app.BazaCalculBrut bcb
ON bcb.Marca = s.Marca
AND bcb.Anul = @Anul
AND bcb.Luna = @Luna
AND bcb.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

LEFT JOIN app.BazaContributii bc
ON bc.Marca = s.Marca
AND bc.Anul = @Anul
AND bc.Luna = @Luna
AND bc.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

LEFT JOIN app.NomGrilaSalarizare ngs
ON ngs.Clasa = s.Clasa
AND ngs.TipMediu = 'U'

OUTER APPLY
(
SELECT
SUM(ISNULL(RataLunara,0)) AS CAR
FROM app.CAR
WHERE Marca = s.Marca
AND Anul = @Anul
AND Luna = @Luna
AND CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
) car2

OUTER APPLY
(
SELECT
SUM
(
ISNULL(Rata,0)
+ ISNULL(Rest,0)
+ ISNULL(Taxa,0)
+ ISNULL(Taxam,0)
) AS PensiiAlimentare
FROM app.PensieAlimentara
WHERE Marca = s.Marca
AND Anul = @Anul
AND Luna = @Luna
AND CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
) pa

OUTER APPLY
(
SELECT
SUM
(
ISNULL(Rata,0)
+ ISNULL(Dobanda,0)
+ ISNULL(Restanta,0)
) AS Imputatii
FROM app.Imputatie
WHERE Marca = s.Marca
AND Anul = @Anul
AND Luna = @Luna
AND CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
) imp

OUTER APPLY
(
SELECT
SUM
(
ISNULL(Rata,0)
+ ISNULL(Dobanda,0)
+ ISNULL(Restanta,0)
) AS Popriri
FROM app.Poprire
WHERE Marca = s.Marca
AND Anul = @Anul
AND Luna = @Luna
AND CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
) pop

OUTER APPLY
(
SELECT

    SUM
    (
        CASE
            WHEN TipRata = 1
            THEN Rata + Dobanda + RestDePlata
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS Chirii,

    SUM
    (
        CASE
            WHEN TipRata = 2
            THEN Rata + Dobanda + RestDePlata
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS Casa,

    SUM
    (
        CASE
            WHEN TipRata = 3
            THEN Rata + Dobanda + RestDePlata
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS Banca,

    SUM
    (
        CASE
            WHEN TipRata = 7
            THEN Rata + Dobanda + RestDePlata
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS PensiiFacultative

FROM app.Retinere

WHERE Marca = s.Marca
  AND Anul = @Anul
  AND Luna = @Luna
  AND CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

) ret

WHERE s.Anul = @Anul
AND s.Luna = @Luna
AND s.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

END TRY

BEGIN CATCH

THROW;

END CATCH

SET NOCOUNT ON;

BEGIN TRY

/*=====================================================
Stergere exceptii vechi
=====================================================*/
DELETE FROM app.ExceptiiLichidare
WHERE Anul = @Anul
AND Luna = @Luna
AND CodSucursala = @CodSucursala;

/*=====================================================
NET NEGATIV
=====================================================*/
INSERT INTO app.ExceptiiLichidare
(
Anul,
Luna,
CodSucursala,

 
Marca,
Nume,

TipExceptie,
Severitate,

Mesaj,

CreatedDate
 

)

SELECT

 
cl.Anul,
cl.Luna,
cl.CodSucursala,

cl.Marca,
cl.Nume,

'NET_NEGATIV',

'BLOCK',

'Net de plata negativ.',

GETDATE()
 

FROM app.CalculLichidare cl

WHERE cl.Anul = @Anul
AND cl.Luna = @Luna
AND cl.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

AND ISNULL(cl.NetDePlata,0) < 0;

/*=====================================================
FARA BRUT
=====================================================*/

(
Anul,
Luna,
CodSucursala,

 
Marca,
Nume,

TipExceptie,
Severitate,

Mesaj,

CreatedDate
 

)

SELECT

 
cl.Anul,
cl.Luna,
cl.CodSucursala,

cl.Marca,
cl.Nume,

'FARA_BRUT',

'WARNING',

'Salariat fara venit brut calculat.',

GETDATE()
 

FROM app.CalculLichidare cl

WHERE cl.Anul = @Anul
AND cl.Luna = @Luna
AND cl.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

AND ISNULL(cl.TotalBrut,0) = 0;

/*=====================================================
FARA PREZENTA
=====================================================*/
INSERT INTO app.ExceptiiLichidare
(
Anul,
Luna,
CodSucursala,

 
Marca,
Nume,

TipExceptie,
Severitate,

Mesaj,

CreatedDate
 

)

SELECT

 
cl.Anul,
cl.Luna,
cl.CodSucursala,

cl.Marca,
cl.Nume,

'FARA_PREZENTA',

'INFO',

'Salariat fara prezenta in luna.',

GETDATE()
 

FROM app.CalculLichidare cl

WHERE cl.Anul = @Anul
AND cl.Luna = @Luna
AND cl.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

AND ISNULL(cl.ZileLucrate,0) = 0
AND ISNULL(cl.ZileCO,0) = 0
AND ISNULL(cl.ZileCM,0) = 0;

/*=====================================================
DEPASIRE CO + CM
=====================================================*/
INSERT INTO app.ExceptiiLichidare
(
Anul,
Luna,
CodSucursala,

 
Marca,
Nume,

TipExceptie,
Severitate,

Mesaj,

CreatedDate
 

)

SELECT

 
cl.Anul,
cl.Luna,
cl.CodSucursala,

cl.Marca,
cl.Nume,

'CO_CM_DEPASIRE',

'WARNING',

'CO + CM depasesc zilele lucratoare.',

GETDATE()
 

FROM app.CalculLichidare cl

WHERE cl.Anul = @Anul
AND cl.Luna = @Luna
AND cl.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

AND
(
ISNULL(cl.ZileCO,0)
+ ISNULL(cl.ZileCM,0)
) > ISNULL(cl.ZileLucratoare,0);

/*=====================================================
RETINERI DEPASITE
=====================================================*/
INSERT INTO app.ExceptiiLichidare
(
Anul,
Luna,
CodSucursala,

 
Marca,
Nume,

TipExceptie,
Severitate,

Mesaj,

CreatedDate
 

)

SELECT

 
cl.Anul,
cl.Luna,
cl.CodSucursala,

cl.Marca,
cl.Nume,

'RETINERI_DEPASITE',

'BLOCK',

'Retinerile depasesc venitul disponibil.',

GETDATE()
 

FROM app.CalculLichidare cl

WHERE cl.Anul = @Anul
AND cl.Luna = @Luna
AND cl.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

AND ISNULL(cl.TotalRetineri,0)
> ISNULL(cl.VenitNet,0);

/*=====================================================
FARA CONTRIBUTII
=====================================================*/
INSERT INTO app.ExceptiiLichidare
(
Anul,
Luna,
CodSucursala,

 
Marca,
Nume,

TipExceptie,
Severitate,

Mesaj,

CreatedDate
 

)

SELECT

 
cl.Anul,
cl.Luna,
cl.CodSucursala,

cl.Marca,
cl.Nume,

'FARA_CONTRIBUTII',

'WARNING',

'Salariat fara contributii calculate.',

GETDATE()
 

FROM app.CalculLichidare cl

WHERE cl.Anul = @Anul
AND cl.Luna = @Luna
AND cl.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

AND ISNULL(cl.TotalBrut,0) > 0

AND ISNULL(cl.CAS,0) = 0
AND ISNULL(cl.CASS,0) = 0;

/*=====================================================
FARA IMPOZIT
=====================================================*/
INSERT INTO app.ExceptiiLichidare
(
Anul,
Luna,
CodSucursala,

 
Marca,
Nume,

TipExceptie,
Severitate,

Mesaj,

CreatedDate
 

)

SELECT

 
cl.Anul,
cl.Luna,
cl.CodSucursala,

cl.Marca,
cl.Nume,

'FARA_IMPOZIT',

'INFO',

'Impozit venit 0.',

GETDATE()
 

FROM app.CalculLichidare cl

WHERE cl.Anul = @Anul
AND cl.Luna = @Luna
AND cl.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

AND ISNULL(cl.BazaImpozabila,0) > 0

AND ISNULL(cl.ImpozitVenit,0) = 0;

END TRY
